_about: Your personal search settings. Claude fills this in during the setup interview and updates it whenever you ask (for example: 'widen the radius to 50 km' or 'add project manager roles'). You never need to edit it by hand. Keys that start with '_' are notes and are ignored by the scripts.
_country_help: Country you are job hunting in, e.g. 'Canada'. Some sources only exist in one country (Job Bank is Canada only).

A._help: Your main target. label: a short name, e.g. 'Customer service leadership'. titles: the job titles to search for, e.g. ['Customer Service Manager', 'Director of Customer Experience'].

B._help: Optional second target, e.g. a step down in seniority or an adjacent field. Leave titles empty to use one track only.

_locations_help: Where to search, in priority order (1 = most wanted). place: a city and province/state, e.g. 'Ottawa, ON'. radius_km: how far around it. For remote jobs anywhere in the country add { 'place': '<country>', 'remote_only': true, 'priority': 1 }.
_sources_help: jobbank: Government of Canada Job Bank, Canada only; days = which nights it runs. company_sites: the career pages listed in company_targets.csv. email_alerts: job-alert emails in Gmail (the only provider supported for now); search = a Gmail search that finds them, e.g. 'from:alerts@example.com'. extra: other sites you asked Claude to add, each { 'name', 'url', 'how', 'added_on', 'terms_checked_by_user' }. Before adding any site, you are responsible for checking that its terms of use allow automated reading.

title_filter._help: Set aside titles before reading the posting. keep_words: if not empty, a title must contain at least one of these (e.g. ['customer', 'service', 'operations']). exclude_words: titles containing any of these are set aside (e.g. ['nurse', 'driver']). Set-aside jobs get score 0 with a note and can be moved back on the dashboard. Claude suggests both lists from your target roles.

scoring._help: How each posting's 0-100 score is built. Weights must add up to 100. The default gives role fit the most weight on purpose: a high weight on location tends to inflate scores for jobs that are nearby but not a real fit. show_on_board_from: the minimum score for the New column on the dashboard.

documents._help: standing_notes: rules for every resume and cover letter, in your own words, e.g. 'Always mention my PMP certification'. Claude adds to this list when you give a rule that should apply every time.

schedule._help: Full setup only: when the nightly scan runs on your computer. The computer must be on (or able to wake) at this time.
